initialExam.title: J&K Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: J&K Police Constable recruitment through JKSSB for constable posts in Jammu & Kashmir Police force.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, J&K GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English, Hindi/Urdu.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Standard Test → Physical Endurance Test → Medical → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit jkssb.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension, Hardship allowance
